newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 7.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
- U.S. President Bill Clinton accepted the resignation of some of his top cabinet officials after winning the country's elections a day earlier.
- U.S. investigators recovered more wreckage from the crash of the Trans World Airlines Flight 800 that might hold clues to the cause of the explosion.
- Western diplomats suspect the Serbs of sending clandestine air shipments of arms to Libya in violation of United Nations sanctions.
- The Repulican Party announced its intention to seek "a common ground" with re-elected President Bill Clinton.
- New York, New Jersey and Conneticut gave Bill Clinton a third of his margin of victory in the country's presidential elections.
